subject: math
description: Use the Pythagorean Theorem to set up squared-side equations and find missing side lengths in right triangles.
learningObjectives: Identify the legs and hypotenuse of a right triangle
Use a^2 + b^2 = c^2 to set up an equation for a missing side
Find a missing hypotenuse by adding the squares of the legs
Find a missing leg by subtracting the known leg square from the hypotenuse square
Check whether a word problem needs the hypotenuse or a leg
prerequisites: Recognize right angles in geometric figures
Use square roots to undo squaring
Solve one-step equations involving addition or subtraction
